name: dsh-theme-admech
description: Pure Forge-Cathedral tech-gothic theme for DSH. v0.9.1: expanded process rows (e.g. 运行命令 / bash) now use the themed terminal glyph, and the composer cogitation gauge opens the very same reasoning slider in place (no detour through model settings). v0.9.0: themed macOS application icon (install/restore scripts), readable recommendation badge, Mars-red primary button in queue/steer/stop states. v0.8.0: one-piece boot prelude takeover, machine-spirit telemetry rail, reasoning slider + cogitation gauge. v0.7.x: Windows fixes, popover framing, DPI-aware hairlines. macOS + Windows verified. 机械神教 · 铸炉圣殿。
